hypothesis: M174 showed that M170 and M171 only lose knife-edge rows, so a margin-split replay guard should separately report robust promotion rows, low-margin watchlist rows, and knife-edge stress rows.
success_criteria: implement or document a margin-split boundary replay guard
classify rows using robust threshold 0.001 and knife-edge threshold 0.0005
evaluate M168, M170, and M171 under the split
require robust-row retention as a hard gate
report low-margin and knife-edge changes separately
decide whether M170 or M171 should receive behavior/protected-key evaluation under the split
failure_criteria: silently relax M164 to pass a failed candidate
discard knife-edge rows without reporting them
promote a candidate without robust-row retention
run more PPO before the split guard is evaluated

commands.name: m175_margin_split_boundary_replay_guard
commands.command: Apply a margin-split replay guard to M168/M170/M171 using M168 margin slack classes.

decision_rule: Only candidates that retain robust promotion rows may proceed to behavior and protected-key evaluation; knife-edge losses must be reported as stress regressions.
